notes.title: Major Hotfix!
notes.content:
Romans!

We know we had a rough start to our empire here on Steam. Following your feedback and reviews, we realized that a big part of it was a major issue caused by a last-moment change we did in the game right before release and caused a lot of problems including crashes, slow loading times, slow switching between graphics settings and more, mainly on low spec computers. We are incredibly sorry to those who experienced problems because of that. We do however have great news - the last update, which is focused on the characters' shaders should fix the majority of those issues! It might also cause some new, smaller issues, but the game should perform and behave a lot better now. We know there are still many issues to take care of, and as promised, we will keep uploading daily updates to the game until everything is resolved and the experience is as good as we intended for everyone. This update however should be a major step and a big improvement. 

Thank you for your feedback, support and honest reviews - we are learning from them and they are helping us renovate Rome!

The Senate.


* In the last update, we also added a crash reporter where you can send us the crash log - by doing that you can help us identify the problems and solve them faster.

notes.title: Hotfix #2
notes.content:
Citizens of Rome!


As promised, we are working hard, while not sleeping enough to fix the issues we had upon release. We know we have a lot of work ahead of us, that the release went a bit wrong and we will need to prove ourselves to you once more. We are determined to do exactly that. 

This hotfix should fix some major issues you brought to our attention, including some crashes, the mouse not getting to the side of the screen. Also, we think we fixed at least one major issue that caused many players to get characters in very low quality and it should improve now. We know there are still many other issues, but we hope this will already make a big difference to the experience. 

We also promise to keep updating hotfixes at least once a day, until all the major issues are resolved, you are happy with us once more and we see your reviews reflect that. We know some people are mad at the moment, and you are right to be, but we are here for one simple reason - to make a great game and a great experience and we are doing and will keep doing everything we can to make it that happen so you can experience what we worked so hard to create without annoying technical issues.
